title: If you wear armor you die!
description: If you wear armor you die! i mean it literally
body:
**Description**
Think you’re a Minecraft pro? Put your survival skills to the ultimate test. This datapack introduces a simple but deadly rule: If you wear even a single piece of armor, you die instantly. No helmets, no chestplates, no leggings, and no boots. Whether it’s leather or netherite, the moment it touches your skin, it’s game over. This forces you to rethink your entire strategy—sneaking past skeletons, avoiding falls, and mastering the art of the shield.

**Key Features**

Instant Enforcement: Uses high-performance tick detection to ensure no one cheats the system.

Full Coverage: Detects all four armor slots simultaneously.

Lightweight: Minimal impact on server performance, written specifically for the 1.21.4 folder structure and command syntax.

Multiplayer Compatible: Works for every player on the server.

**How to Use
** Install: Drop the folder into your world’s datapacks folder.

Activate: Run /reload in-game.

Verify: Type /datapack list to ensure "No Armor Challenge" is green.

Challenge: Try to beat the Ender Dragon while remaining completely unarmored!

Warning: This datapack is unforgiving. If you have "Auto-Equip" mods or accidentally right-click armor in your hotbar, you will meet your maker. Good luck.
